info.title: MateCollab API
info.summary: Same-origin REST API for the MateCollab web client.
info.description:
Conventions (naming, pagination, errors, idempotency, rate limits) are defined in
docs/api/API-DESIGN.md. This document is the source of truth for request and response
shapes: TypeScript types are generated from it and the Go handlers are tested against it.

Within `/api/v1` changes are additive only. Clients must tolerate unknown fields and
unknown enum values.

Tenant resources live under `/orgs/{orgId}`. The caller's membership is resolved before
any handler runs; organisations the caller does not belong to (and resources of other
organisations) answer `404`, never `403`.

servers.description: Same origin as the web application

tags.name: platform
tags.description: Deployment metadata and runtime client configuration.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Sign-in, sessions, password recovery, email verification and two-step verification.

tags.name: account
tags.description: The signed-in user's global profile, email addresses and preferences.

tags.name: organisations
tags.description: Organisations, the organisation switcher and organisation settings.

tags.name: members
tags.description: The member directory, roles and membership status.

tags.name: invitations
tags.description: Invitations by email, from creation to acceptance.

get.description:
Public, unauthenticated deployment settings the web client needs before sign-in: build
version, realtime endpoint, media server URL, upload limit and deployment-level feature
switches. Contains no secrets and no organisation or user data.

Cache-Control.description: Always `no-cache`; clients revalidate on every load.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Unknown email, wrong password and disabled accounts produce the same `401 invalid_credentials`. Limited per address and per account (`429 rate_limited` with `Retry-After`), with a progressive delay after repeated failures. A session the browser already holds is revoked.

200.description: Signed in (session cookie set) or a second step is required (MFA cookie set).

post.summary: Complete sign-in with an authenticator or recovery code
post.description: Uses the `__Host-mc_mfa` challenge cookie from the password step. A wrong code answers `401 invalid_code`; the fifth failure (or an expired challenge) answers `401 mfa_challenge_expired` and the user starts again. Codes and recovery codes are single use.

200.description: Signed in; the session cookie is set.

204.description: Signed out; the cookie is cleared.

200.description: The signed-in user, CSRF token, session and organisations.

202.description: Accepted. The response is the same whether or not the address has an account.

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset or setup link
post.description: Tokens are single use and expire (reset 60 minutes, account setup 72 hours). An invalid, used or expired token answers `422` with a `token` field error.

204.description: Password set; every session of the account is revoked.

put.description: Requires a recent password check (`403 reauthentication_required`).

200.description: Changed; other sessions are revoked and this browser gets a new session.

post.summary: Confirm the password for a sensitive action

204.description: Revoked. Sessions of other users answer 404.

200.description: A new secret to confirm with a code.

post.summary: Confirm enrolment and turn two-step verification on

200.description: Enabled; recovery codes are shown once.
New codes; earlier codes stop working.

201.description: Added unverified; a verification email is queued.

204.description: Removed. The primary address cannot be removed.

post.description:
Needs a recent password check (`403 reauthentication_required`). Owners must transfer
ownership first (`409 ownership_transfer_required`). The account stays usable for a 30-day
grace period, during which the request can be cancelled; afterwards it is anonymised (name
replaced with "Deleted user", sign-in details and email addresses removed, memberships
deactivated) and content stays in its organisations.

202.description: Scheduled; a confirmation email is queued.

204.description: Cancelled (`409 no_deletion_requested` when nothing was pending).

post.summary: Describe an invitation to the holder of its link
post.description: Unknown, tampered or revoked links answer `404 invitation_invalid`.

Signed in: the account must own the invited address (`403 invitation_email_mismatch`). Signed out: an existing account must sign in first (`401 sign_in_required`); otherwise an account is created. Used, expired and invalid links answer `409 invitation_used`, `409 invitation_expired` and `404 invitation_invalid`.

200.description: Joined. For a new account the session cookie is set.

post.description: Only when self-service sign-up is enabled (`403 org_signup_disabled` otherwise). Operators create organisations with `mcctl org create`.

201.description: Created; the caller is its Owner.

ETag.description: Settings version; send it back in `If-Match`.

put.description: Requires `org.security.manage`. Requiring two-step verification needs it on the caller's own account first (`409 mfa_required_for_policy`).

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The `ETag` of the version being replaced (`428` when missing, `412` when stale).

ETag.description: Settings version; send it back in `If-Match`.

get.description: Every member can read their own entry; others need `org.directory.view`.

patch.summary: Change a member's role or status

200.description: Updated; access changes apply to the member's next request.

post.description: Members need `org.members.invite`, Guests `org.guests.invite`, Admins `org.admins.manage`. Limited to 30 per hour per inviter and 200 per day per organisation. Invitations expire after 7 days.

201.description: Created; the invitation email is queued.

delete.description: The inviter, or someone who manages members (Admins for Admin invitations).

200.description: Resent; earlier links stop working and the expiry restarts.

post.description:
Owner only, after a recent password check (`403 reauthentication_required`). The target must
be an active Admin whose account is not scheduled for deletion (`409 transfer_target_not_admin`,
`409 transfer_target_inactive`, `409 transfer_to_self`). In one transaction the target becomes
the Owner and the previous Owner becomes an Admin; an audit event is recorded.

patch.summary: Update my title and contact email in this organisation

session.name: __Host-mc_session
session.description: Opaque session cookie (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax). Never readable by scripts.

csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrf.description:
Required with the session on every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE, together with a
same-origin `Origin`. The value comes from `GET /auth/session`.

webClient.name: X-MC-Client
webClient.description:
Pre-session CSRF guard for sign-in, recovery and invitation endpoints: the value `web`
plus a same-origin `Origin`. Cross-site pages cannot send it without a CORS preflight,
which the API never grants.

OrgId.name: orgId
OrgId.description: Organisation ID. Organisations the caller does not belong to answer 404.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor from `page.next_cursor`; only valid with the same filters.

RuntimeConfig.description: Deployment settings exposed to the web client before sign-in.

environment.description: Deployment environment. Clients treat unknown values as `production`.

version.description: Build version of the API, e.g. `0.1.0+3f2c9a1`.

public_url.description: Canonical origin users open (the same origin serves the API).

protocol.description: Newest WebSocket subprotocol the server speaks.

livekit_url.description: LiveKit signalling URL (`wss://` in production); null when media is not configured.

max_upload_bytes.description: Platform ceiling for one file; organisations can only lower it.

org_signup.description: Whether new organisations can be created through self-service sign-up.

ProblemDetails.description:
RFC 9457 problem details, served as `application/problem+json`. `code` is the stable,
machine-readable value clients branch on; `type` is `urn:matecollab:problem:<code>`.
Details never include internal state, SQL, stack traces or data from other organisations.

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the problem type.

detail.description: Explanation specific to this occurrence, safe to show to the user.

instance.description: Request path that produced the problem (query string excluded).

request_id.description: Correlates with server logs; quote it when contacting support.

field.description: JSON path of the field, e.g. `name` or `members[2].role`.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision.

NullableTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when the event has not happened.

PageInfo.description:
Cursor pagination state returned next to `data` in list responses. Cursors are opaque,
signed and bound to the query's filters; offsets are never used.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page.

Role.description:
Organisation role. There is exactly one `owner`; ownership changes only by transfer.
Clients must tolerate unknown values.

InvitableRole.description: Role an invitation grants. Nobody is invited as Owner.

MembershipStatus.description:
`active` members can use the organisation; `suspended` and `deactivated` members cannot.
Deactivated members stay in the directory for history.

User.description: The signed-in user's global profile (shared by every organisation they belong to).

deletion_scheduled_at.description: When a pending account deletion takes effect; null when none is pending.

UserUpdate.description: JSON Merge Patch of the profile; omitted fields are unchanged.

SessionDocument.description: Everything the web client needs at start-up. Never contains the session token.

csrf_token.description: Send as `X-CSRF-Token` on every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.

LoginResponse.description:
Either a challenge (`mfa_required: true`, with the short-lived `__Host-mc_mfa` cookie set) or a
new session (cookie set, `session` included).

TokenRequest.description: A one-time token from an email link's URL fragment (never sent in a URL).

new_password.description: 12–128 characters, not a common password and not the email address.

code.description: Authenticator code; required when two-step verification is on.

data.description: Active sessions, the current one first.

TOTPSetup.description: Shown once during enrolment. The secret is only active after `/auth/mfa/totp/enable`.

qr_code.description: PNG data URL of the otpauth URI.

RecoveryCodes.description: Shown once. Each code works a single time.

Preferences.description: Personal settings that follow the user across devices.

slug.description: URL name used in web addresses (`/{slug}/home`).

OrganisationSummary.description: An organisation the user is an active member of (organisation switcher).

slug.description: 3–40 lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens; some names are reserved.

SecuritySettings.description: The organisation's `security` settings section (replaced as a whole).

require_2fa.description: Members without two-step verification cannot use the organisation until they enrol.

session_max_age.description: Absolute session age accepted for this organisation.

invite_permission.description: Who may invite Members (Admins always can).

SecuritySettingsDocument.description: Security settings with the version to send back in `If-Match`.

email.description: The member's contact address for this organisation.

UpdateMemberRequest.description:
Change another member's role and/or status. Nobody changes themselves or the Owner; only
the Owner grants, revokes or manages Admins; Owner is reached only by ownership transfer.

Invitation.description: An invitation as seen by organisation administrators (never includes the token).

InvitationPreview.description: What the holder of an invitation link sees before accepting.

account_exists.description: True when the invited address already has an account (sign in to accept).

AcceptInvitationRequest.description:
The organisation and role always come from the stored invitation; they cannot be supplied.
`display_name` and `password` are required only when a new account is created.

signed_in.description: True when the browser now has a session (always, after creating an account).

user_id.description: An active Admin of the organisation.

MembershipProfileUpdate.description:
JSON Merge Patch of the caller's own membership. Role, status and organisation cannot be
changed here (unknown fields are rejected).

title.description: Job title shown to co-members; null or empty clears it.

contact_email.description: Must be one of the caller's confirmed email addresses.

scheduled_at.description: When the account will be anonymised unless the request is cancelled first.

Problem.description: Error described as RFC 9457 problem details.

X-Request-ID.description: Request correlation identifier (also in the body as `request_id`).

value.title: Not Found
value.detail: The requested resource was not found.
